fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political commentary on Miami municipal affairs (including criticism of "Sewellism" and actions of Commissioners Williams and Rigby), discussion of alleged gambling operations (marble boards and "Lucky" games at Miami Beach), and reporting on a shooting of a Tribune reporter in the Tribune offices with the victim hospitalized at Jackson Memorial Hospital. Also covers a dispute over Southern Bell telephone rates and property valuation before the State Railroad Commission, along with recurring columns ("Rambles and Rumbles," "Tips & Topics"), notices and advertisements, and community items including a planned July 4 outing for children.
